name: Cevraya
description: An elf shaman of the Golgari with a claim to Vraska's throne.

timeline.summary: Vraska planeswalks in to claim her throne and the Golgari leaders bow to her without challenge.
timeline.quote: Madame Storrev, Mister Azdomas, Mister Varolz, and Miss Cevraya all bowed immediately, saying in unison, "No, my queen."

pages_say.description: An elf shaman of the Golgari with a claim to Vraska's throne.
